title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 2
subtitle: File IO, arrays, random numbers, pointers, references, strings, vectors, new/delete, preparing for Quiz 2
description: Everything in the Week 2 slides and lecture videos, taught from scratch: file streams and seeking, C-style arrays, random numbers, pointers and references (with a step-by-step memory diagram), std::string and getline, stringstreams, vectors, and dynamic memory with new and delete. Runnable code in every lesson, the pointer practice sheet worked, a mock quiz and a cheat sheet.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 2 scope
Quiz 2 is written at the start of lab on the Learning Hub, in the same format as Quiz 1 (multiple choice, true/false, matching, what-does-this-print). It covers the **Week 2 slides**, the **lecture videos**, and the **Pointers and References practice** sheet. Every program from the slides is reproduced here, runnable and explained line by line; the practice sheet is worked in full.
:::

steps.note: take it cold first, so you know where the gaps are (about 45 min)
step through the practice activity in the memory widget until you can predict every x and y
alias, must be initialized, cannot be re-seated; the two meanings of &
the memory-leak walkthrough and the fix; delete vs delete[]
tellg/tellp and the four seekp examples, by hand
the getline failure table is a guaranteed what-does-this-print
redo the practice sheet on paper, then check
print it and read it on the way in

lessons.title: File streams: open, close, read, copy
